boundsPortedFromTheOracle.availability: src/state.js: `(isAdvanced() || diveMode === 'ccr') && gameState === 'diving'`, decided by the dive mode itself. The mode is carried in the save from v3 on.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.cycle: src/state.js: CCR toggles 0 and 5; open circuit steps 1 to 4, skipping 2 when tankCount <= 3, and wraps to 0. Escape returns to 0.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.cylinderPage: src/renderer.js infoPageMode 1 and 2, three cylinders per page: label, mix, pressure `Math.round(gasRemaining / volume)` marked danger under 50 bar, MOD `Math.floor(((PO2_HIGH / fO2) - 1) * 10)`, and the ACTIVE marker.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.tissuePage: infoPageMode 3: per compartment `(pN2 + pHe) / (a + pAmb / b)` with combined N2/He coefficients, clamped to 0..1.2, danger at 1.0, with markers under compartments 1, 4, 8, 12 and 16.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.decoPage: infoPageMode 4: GF99 and SrfGF as `Math.max(0, Math.round(max((pt - p) / (M(p) - p) * 100)))` at the current ambient pressure and at 1.0 bar, each danger at 100 or more; ceiling; GF low and high; TTS; NDL, shown as '---' at the 999 sentinel and danger under 5; PO2.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.loopPage: infoPageMode 5: loop PO2, marked outside 0.16..1.6 bar (PO2_HYPOXIA, PO2_HIGH), which differs from the HUD row's 0.18; setpoint; mode, with BAIL in the danger tone; O2 cylinder pressure and volume; diluent pressure, volume and mix; scrubber minutes. The cylinder and scrubber limits (30 bar, 10 min, rounded) are shared with the HUD through src/app/loop-danger.ts.

switchDepthDecision.question: #158 left open whether a per-tank switch depth joins TankState or is computed on demand.
switchDepthDecision.decision: Computed on demand: maximumOperatingDepthM() in src/planner/dive-planner.ts, carried in the presentation snapshot as PresentationTank.modM.
switchDepthDecision.why: Legacy maintains switchDepth per tank (gsAddTank, gsAdjustO2) but reads it only on its setup screen. The one place its gas logic consulted it, the staging check in physics.js bestGasForDepth, is commented out as DISABLED. A stored field would carry a number nothing decides with, and would need a save-format change.

deliberateDesign.panelUnderTheHud: The HUD and the panel share a left column (.wreck-column) that carries the position the HUD used to have. An open page sits below the readouts, so NDL stays visible, which #137 §4.4.1 requires. The column's height stops above the bottom controls, and the panel scrolls inside the space left. A panel on the right would be squeezed to a sliver at 390 px, and one over the HUD would hide NDL.
deliberateDesign.notADialog: A labelled region, not a dialog: the dive keeps running, nothing is modal, and focus stays where it was. The toggle carries aria-controls, aria-expanded and aria-keyshortcuts 'I'.
deliberateDesign.uiStateNotModelState: Which page is open changes nothing the model or the save knows about, so it lives in wreck-app.ts and not in the controller.
deliberateDesign.keysClaimedOnlyWhenTheyAct: I only where the overlay exists, Escape only while it is open, and never with Ctrl, Meta or Alt held, so browser shortcuts keep working.
deliberateDesign.figuresShareThePlannersCoefficients: compartmentSaturation() uses calculateCeiling()'s combined coefficients. A unit test checks that at the ceiling depth the leading compartment's gradient factor equals GF high, to 1e-9.
deliberateDesign.rebuildOnlyOnChange: The panel body is rebuilt only when its content changes, roughly once a second as the tissues move. It holds nothing focusable that a rebuild could discard.

saveFormatV3.change: SaveGame gains diveMode ('rec' | 'tec' | 'ccr'), validated so that ccr appears exactly when the state has a loop. createSaveGame and LocalSaveRepository.save take it as an optional trailing argument, which defaults to the mode inferred from the dive.
saveFormatV3.why: A technical dive starts with one cylinder, so its state alone looks recreational. Mode decides what the diver is offered, and after a resume the setup screen the reload draws is not the dive being resumed. The gradient factors went into v2 for the same reason.
saveFormatV3.migrations: A v2 save is migrated as save-game-v2, with the gradient factors kept and the mode inferred from the dive. A v1 save is migrated as save-game-v1, with default factors and an inferred mode. A legacy v2 save carries its own diveMode, so that migration is lossless. A v3 save with a missing, unknown or contradictory mode is rejected as invalid-data rather than silently inferred.
saveFormatV3.composition: wreck-app.ts takes the mode from the save when the dive is resumed and from the setup screen when it is new. It writes the mode into every save.

zeroOxygenCrash.finding: major regression — maximumOperatingDepthM threw for 0% oxygen, which the setup allows, so every frame threw and the dive never started.
zeroOxygenCrash.fix: The MOD is null for 0% oxygen and the page shows the unavailable mark. A unit test builds a snapshot with a 0% mix.

singleCylinderTechnical.finding: major contract-violation — the default technical dive has one cylinder, and counting cylinders hid gas information on it.
singleCylinderTechnical.assessment: Confirmed. The first cut recorded this as a known gap, but it is the default configuration, not an edge case.
singleCylinderTechnical.fix: Save format v3 carries the dive mode (see saveFormatV3). Unit tests cover the codec, and an e2e covers the default technical dive before and after a reload.

loopPageVolumes.finding: minor contract-violation — legacy's O2 V and DIL V rows were missing.
loopPageVolumes.fix: Both volumes are carried in PresentationCcr and shown as rows; the e2e asserts the default 2 L and 3 L.

loopPagePo2Threshold.finding: minor contract-violation — the page used the HUD row's 0.18 bar where legacy's page uses 0.16.
loopPagePo2Threshold.fix: isLoopPagePo2Danger() applies 0.16 and 1.6. Unit tests show 0.17 bar marked on the HUD row and not on the page. This is not covered end to end, because a loop resumed at 0.17 bar climbs out of range within a second.

surface.finding: minor contract-violation: pages offered at the surface, where legacy requires gameState diving.
surface.fix: gasInfoAvailable requires status diving. A unit test covers it.

colourTiers.finding: minor contract-violation: the pages carried only danger, dropping legacy caution and warning tones.
colourTiers.assessment: Confirmed. Legacy tints cautions with colour alone and gives the glyph only to danger.
colourTiers.fix: Legacy tiers and thresholds as pure functions with boundary unit tests. Danger keeps the warning glyph. Caution and warning tint an already legible value and add a hidden word for assistive technology.

ndlCap.finding: minor contract-violation: finite NDL not capped at 99 minutes as legacy draws it.
ndlCap.fix: displayedNdlMinutes caps at 99 and returns null for the 999 sentinel. The page shows whole minutes.
